article.headline: Houston heads to San Antonio for conference showdown
article.description: Houston Rockets (1-0, third in the Western Conference) vs. San Antonio Spurs (0-1, eighth in the Western Conference)
article.title: Houston heads to San Antonio for conference showdown
article.linkText: Houston heads to San Antonio for conference showdown
article.story: Houston Rockets (1-0, third in the Western Conference) vs. San Antonio Spurs (0-1, eighth in the Western Conference) Austin, Texas; Friday, 9:30 p.m. EDT LINE: Spurs -7.5; over/under is 226.5 BOTTOM LINE: Houston travels to San Antonio for a Western Conference matchup. San Antonio went 62-20 overall, 13-3 in Southwest Division action and 32-8 at home last season. The Spurs averaged 119.8 points per game last season, 52.1 in the paint, 17.1 off of turnovers and 16.3 on fast breaks. Houston finished 52-30 overall, 10-6 in Southwest Division games and 22-19 on the road last season. The Rockets shot 47.9% from the field and 36.4% from 3-point range last season. INJURIES: Spurs: Jayden Quaintance: out (knee), Tobias Harris: day to day (calf). Rockets: Steven Adams: out (calf). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
